scientific_integrity: An exhaustive 630-by-630 paired-ranking classification and an independent 5040-by-5040 full-ranking enumeration were run from included standalone source. scientific_limitations: Exactly two agents and seven allocated indivisible goods; all three singleton rankings strict.
Count and orbit structure apply to the qualitative SD-EF1 relation, not arbitrary tied valuations or larger instances.
The exact probability requires independent uniform strict rankings, not independent uniform cardinal utilities.
title: Two obstruction types at the seven-good simultaneous SD-EF1 boundary
